parts:
A few edits/suggestions I noticed:

### Main Conference Section
- **“Community attendees who register now through May 31 may secure…”**
  - This sentence is a little clunky. Consider:
  - “Community attendees who register by May 31 can secure discounted tickets for $100 (regularly $150).”

- **“full price $150”**
  - Add punctuation:
  - “(full price: $150)” or “(regular price: $150)”

- The paragraph:
  - “The Positive Schools Conference is more than a day of professional learning, it’s an investment…”
  - Needs punctuation after “learning”
  - Corrected:
  - “The Positive Schools Conference is more than a day of professional learning. It’s an investment in stronger schools and communities.”

### Volunteer Section
- **“usher attendees to open auditorium seats”**
  - Sounds awkward. Better options:
    - “help attendees find open auditorium seats”
    - “guide attendees to available auditorium seating”

- **“Volunteers will be allowed to sit in on event activities…”**
  - “Allowed” feels slightly harsh/corporate.
  - Softer:
    - “Volunteers are welcome to participate in event activities when not actively volunteering…”

- **“throughout the event day”**
  - Slightly awkward phrasing.
  - Better:
    - “throughout the day”
    - “during downtime throughout the event”

### Design Suggestions
- The yellow buttons with purple text are eye-catching, but the contrast is slightly hard to read on mobile.
  - Consider:
    - darker purple
    - bolding text more
    - slightly reducing text size so it doesn’t feel cramped

- The volunteer hands graphic is fun, but it feels disconnected from the modern/conference branding above.
  - You may want to:
    - use a cleaner vector style
    - or incorporate the same colorful abstract shapes from the conference graphic for consistency

- The email overall is very long vertically on mobile.
  - Consider shortening text blocks or using:
    - icons
    - section dividers
    - shorter bullets
  - Especially in the volunteer paragraph.

### Tiny Grammar/Style Improvements
- “help us make this event the best it can be!”
  - Slightly more polished:
  - “help us make this event a success!”
  - or
  - “help us create an incredible event experience!”

Overall though, the energy and colors are strong and community-focused. It feels welcoming and upbeat.
